description: Use this first when a user asks whether a Canadian price is a good deal, or whether a product is cheaper at another Canadian store. Give it a retailer product link, a lowvyn.com link or id, or a product name, plus the offered price in CAD if there is one. One call returns the product, Lowvyn's verdict ('real_deal', 'modest_deal', 'average', 'bad_time', 'insufficient_data') with a plain explanation, the lowest price ever tracked, the same product's price at other Canadian retailers, and the cheapest one if it beats the checked price. When matched by name (matchedBy='search'), confirm the product with the user or pick from alternatives. watchUrl is a lowvyn.com link where the user can get an email when the price drops.

price.description: The price being offered, in CAD. Omit to check the current tracked price

product.description: A retailer product URL (amazon.ca, walmart.ca, bestbuy.ca, canadiantire.ca, canadacomputers.com, newegg.ca, visions.ca), a lowvyn.com product URL or Lowvyn ID, or a product name to look up

name: check_deal
title: Check a deal
